    Grade your real history

    Your transcripts stay on your device — they're parsed in this browser tab. Nothing uploads.

    How to get the file (Claude.ai)

    ⚠️ Heads-up: the Claude mobile app has no Export button. You have to go through claude.ai in a browser — but a phone browser works fine, you do NOT need a laptop.

    1. Open claude.ai in a browser (Safari / Chrome on your phone is fine — just NOT the Claude app)
    2. Sign in → tap your profile / Settings
    3. Scroll to Privacy → tap Export data
    4. Anthropic emails you a zip (usually within an hour)
    5. On the phone, open the email → tap to download the zip → unzip via the Files app
    6. Inside the unzipped folder, find conversations.json and tap the button below to pick it
    How to get the file (ChatGPT)

    ⚠️ Same story — the ChatGPT mobile app doesn't expose Export either. Use a browser.

    1. Open chat.openai.com in a browser (phone browser works — NOT the ChatGPT app)
    2. Settings → Data Controls → Export data
    3. OpenAI emails you a zip
    4. Unzip via your Files app, find conversations.json, tap the button below
    🚀 Don't want to wait for the export? Just take the quiz

    The quiz path gives you a persona in 60 seconds, no export needed. Same card, same shareable result.

    …or drag & drop it here (desktop)

    What we send & store

    Sent: just { niceness, scale, source } — three numbers + strings.
    NOT sent: IP address, browser fingerprint, cookies, your transcripts, your name.
    Used for: the global histogram only.
    Never: sold, shared, or used as training data. See PRIVACY + worker source.
